headerDisplay: Tapo cloud diagnostic plus energy-history prototype. The cloud test uses TP-Link account login; live P110M telemetry is not yet enabled for aggregation.
footerDisplay: The cloud diagnostic is read-only. Account credentials entered in the custom UI are not stored in plugin settings.

simulationMode.title: Simulation mode
simulationMode.description: Keep enabled until real Tapo integration is implemented.

enableMatterMeter.title: Publish Matter energy sensor
enableMatterMeter.description: Requires Matter enabled on this Homebridge bridge and Homebridge 2.2.0 or later. Publishes estimated totals only; real Tapo counters will be a separate meter.

simulatedPowerW.title: Simulated power (W)
simulatedPowerW.description: Fallback power for the single demo device when Simulated devices is empty.

dataDirectory.title: Data directory (optional)
dataDirectory.description: Leave empty to use the Homebridge storage directory.

simulatedDevices.title: Simulated devices
simulatedDevices.description: Add one row per test device. These are simulated readings, not physical Tapo devices.

tapoCloudPython.title: Python executable for Tapo cloud
tapoCloudPython.description: Use python3 or an absolute path to a Python 3.10+ virtual-environment interpreter.
